emotionPrompts.love: Guide me through Scriptures about love, faithfulness, and serving others today.
emotionPrompts.anxiety: I feel anxious. Give me calm, grounding Scriptures and a short prayer for this moment.
emotionPrompts.healing: I need healing. Help me with passages about restoration and hope, plus one practical step.
emotionPrompts.anger: I am struggling with anger. Show me verses that lead me toward wisdom, restraint, and grace.

breath.title: Breath prayer
breath.prompt: Pause twice today for a short breath prayer.
breath.step1: Find a quiet spot. Inhale slowly and pray: "Lord, You are near."
breath.step2: Exhale and release one worry you cannot control today.
breath.step3: Repeat once more before your next task. Carry the calm with you.

gratitude.title: Gratitude pause
gratitude.prompt: Name three gifts before the day rushes ahead.
gratitude.step1: Thank God for one person who has been kind to you recently.
gratitude.step2: Thank Him for one ordinary mercy you often overlook.
gratitude.step3: Thank Him for one hope you are still carrying. Let gratitude soften your heart.

scripture.title: Scripture anchor
scripture.prompt: Let one verse steady your attention today.
scripture.step1: Read today's verse slowly — once aloud, once silently.
scripture.step2: Choose one phrase that stands out and repeat it three times.
scripture.step3: Ask: "How might this truth shape my next conversation or decision?"

silence.title: Sacred silence
silence.prompt: Give God three minutes without filling the space.
silence.step1: Set a gentle timer. Sit comfortably and close your eyes.
silence.step2: When thoughts arise, return to a single word: "Jesus" or "Peace."
silence.step3: Before the timer ends, whisper one honest sentence to God and listen.

service.title: Quiet service
service.prompt: Love someone today in a small, unseen way.
service.step1: Ask God to bring one person to mind who may need encouragement.
service.step2: Choose one concrete act: a message, a prayer, or a practical help.
service.step3: Do it without announcing it. Offer the act as a simple gift to God.

trust.title: Trust reset
trust.prompt: Release what you cannot carry alone.
trust.step1: Name aloud one situation that feels heavy or uncertain.
trust.step2: Pray: "Father, I cannot control this. I choose to trust Your care."
trust.step3: Take one wise step you can take today, then leave the rest with God.

rest.title: Sabbath moment
rest.prompt: Receive rest as a gift, not a reward.
rest.step1: Step away from one screen or task for five minutes.
rest.step2: Breathe deeply. Remember that your worth is not measured by output.
rest.step3: Thank God for rest already given — sleep, breath, salvation — and receive it again.

commentaries.peace: This verse calls us to deep trust. Psychology reminds us that anxiety is born of trying to control the future. The Bible offers an alternative: yielding control to God who knows our path. Breathe in this promise.
commentaries.faith: Faith is not the absence of doubt, but faithfulness despite it. When walking through darkness, remember that God does not require you to have perfect sight, but to hold His hand.
commentaries.courage: Courage is not the absence of fear, but the conviction that something else is more important. God promises His presence, which means you never fight alone.
commentaries.love: God's love is unconditional — you don't have to earn or buy it. Open your heart to receive this ocean of grace and carry it to others today.
commentaries.generic: God's Word has the power to transform our thinking. Pause and allow this truth to penetrate deeply into your situation today. God is with you.

prayers.peace: Lord, I surrender my anxieties to You. You are my refuge and peace. Grant that I may rest in Your promises and trust Your path. Amen.
prayers.faith: Fearless Father, increase my faith. When I cannot see the path, give me the strength to take the next step in trust of You. Amen.
prayers.courage: Lord, fill my heart with fortitude. In the face of difficulties, remind me that You walk before me and give me the strength to overcome barriers. Amen.
prayers.love: God, thank You for Your incomprehensible love. Grant that I may be a living reflection of Your goodness today to everyone I meet. Amen.
prayers.generic: Lord, thank You for these words of encouragement and truth. May they bear fruit in my life. Guide me in Your paths today. Amen.

boundaries.default: I am not a priest. For sacramental, doctrinal, crisis, or mental-health guidance, please speak with a priest, pastor, or qualified professional.
boundaries.crisis: If you may harm yourself or someone else, contact local emergency services or a crisis line now and tell a nearby trusted person immediately.

default.reflection: Begin with what the text shows about God's character before you rush to application. Let Scripture shape the conversation instead of pressure or fear.
default.step: Read the passage once slowly, once aloud, and ask: what is God inviting me to trust, receive, or obey today?
default.prayer: Lord, steady my heart in Your word. Give me light for this moment and grace for the next faithful step. Amen.

study.reflection: Look at the surrounding verses, repeated words, and the wider story of the chapter. Good understanding usually comes from context before conclusions.
study.step: Read five verses before and after this passage, then write one sentence about the main idea before you look for a personal takeaway.
study.prayer: God of truth, teach me to read carefully, humbly, and with love for what Your word actually says. Amen.

prayer.reflection: Prayer does not need polished language. Bring God what is true, ask for mercy and wisdom, and let Scripture carry what you cannot say clearly.
prayer.step: Name one burden honestly, one gift to thank God for, and one person to place before Him today.
prayer.prayer: Father, receive what I carry today. Give me peace, honesty, and trust as I stand before You. Amen.

anxiety.reflection: God often meets an unsettled heart with nearness before answers. Scripture invites you to slow down, breathe, and remember that you are not carrying this moment alone.
anxiety.step: Take three slow breaths, loosen your shoulders, and repeat one phrase from Scripture before you make the next decision.
anxiety.prayer: Lord Jesus, quiet what is racing in me. Hold my mind in peace and teach me to rest in Your presence right now. Amen.

guidance.reflection: Discernment is often quieter than it is dramatic. Look for what is wise, honest, loving, and aligned with Scripture instead of chasing certainty at any cost.
guidance.step: Name the decision, write the two wisest next actions, and ask which path best reflects truth, love, and integrity.
guidance.prayer: God, lead me in wisdom, not hurry. Close what is harmful, strengthen what is good, and show me a step clear enough to obey. Amen.

forgiveness.reflection: Forgiveness does not deny pain or erase wisdom. It begins by naming the truth, releasing revenge, and asking God to free the heart from the rule of the wound.
forgiveness.step: Name the hurt honestly before God, then ask for grace to release one small part of the debt today without pretending the wound was small.
forgiveness.prayer: Merciful God, I cannot heal this by force. Meet me in the pain and teach me the next honest step toward forgiveness and freedom. Amen.

doubt.reflection: Doubt does not end the conversation with God. Bring your questions into the light and let Scripture hold honesty and hope together.
doubt.step: Write the truest question you are carrying today and place it beside one thing you still know about God from Scripture.
doubt.prayer: Lord, meet me inside these questions. Keep me honest, near, and give me enough light for the next faithful step. Amen.

crisis.reflection: Your safety comes first right now. This is a moment to reach real human support immediately, not carry it alone in silence.
crisis.step: Move away from anything you could use to harm yourself, contact emergency services or a crisis line now, and tell a trusted person nearby exactly what is happening.
crisis.prayer: God, hold me and preserve me in this moment. Send immediate help, protection, and people who will stay with me now. Amen.

affirmations.title: Biblical affirmations
affirmations.subtitle: God's word for your heart. Strengthen your faith with His promises.
affirmations.emptyHint: Pick a category to see affirmations.

identityBeloved.title: I am God's beloved child
identityBeloved.body: God chose me and called me His child. His love does not depend on what I do — it is a gift. Today I rest in this truth: I am loved, accepted, and safe in His Father's heart.

identityNewCreation.title: I am a new creation in Christ
identityNewCreation.body: In Christ the old has passed away, and everything has become new. My past shame, mistakes, and fears no longer define who I am. Today I live as a new creation — with a clean slate and a holy calling.

peaceNotAsWorld.title: God's peace guards my heart
peaceNotAsWorld.body: The peace Jesus gives is not the peace the world offers. It does not depend on circumstances. Today I take a deep breath and let His peace guard my heart and mind.

peaceAnxiousNothing.title: I am anxious for nothing
peaceAnxiousNothing.body: I bring every concern to God today. With thanksgiving I present my requests to Him. I trust His peace — which surpasses understanding — to guard my heart in Christ.

strengthCanDo.title: I can do all things through Christ
strengthCanDo.body: I do not rely on my own strength. Whatever stands before me today, I can do it through Him who strengthens me. His power works in me as I move forward step by step.

strengthBeStrong.title: God is with me wherever I go
strengthBeStrong.body: Be strong and courageous. I will not fear or be dismayed, for the Lord my God is with me wherever I go. His presence walks ahead of me and rests within me.

faithMountains.title: My faith moves mountains
faithMountains.body: Even if my faith is as small as a mustard seed, in God it is enough. Today I choose to believe beyond what I see and to trust His power in my situation.

healingStripes.title: By His wounds I am healed
healingStripes.body: Jesus carried my weakness and sickness. By His wounds I am healed — in body, soul, and spirit. Today I receive His healing presence in every area of my life.

hopeFuture.title: God has a hope-filled plan for me
hopeFuture.body: God knows the thoughts He thinks toward me — thoughts of peace and not of evil, to give me a future and a hope. I walk forward confident that He directs my steps.

loveNothingSeparate.title: Nothing separates me from God's love
loveNothingSeparate.body: Neither death nor life, neither present nor future — nothing can separate me from the love of God in Christ Jesus. Today I live anchored in that unwavering love.

lovePerfectCastsOut.title: Perfect love casts out fear
lovePerfectCastsOut.body: There is no fear in love; perfect love casts out fear. Today I accept that I am safe in God's love — complete, perfect, and enough.

gratitudeEveryGood.title: Every good gift comes from above
gratitudeEveryGood.body: Every good gift and every perfect thing comes from above, from the Father of lights. Today I give thanks for the small and great blessings that come from His hand.

identityChosenRoyal.title: I am chosen, a royal priesthood
identityChosenRoyal.body: I am part of a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God's own possession. Today I live as one who proclaims the excellencies of Him who called me out of darkness into His marvelous light.

identityTemple.title: My body is a temple of the Spirit
identityTemple.body: My body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who lives in me. I am not my own — I have been bought with a price. Today I honor my body, mind, and soul as God's dwelling place.

identityImage.title: I am made in God's image
identityImage.body: God created me in His own image, in His likeness. I carry worth, dignity, and purpose that nothing can take away. Today I live conscious of my identity as a reflection of the Creator.

peaceCastCares.title: I cast every care on God
peaceCastCares.body: I cast all my anxieties on God, because He cares for me. Today I do not carry burdens that are not mine to carry. His shoulders are strong enough to hold it all.

peaceBeStill.title: I am still, and I know He is God
peaceBeStill.body: I am still and I know that He is God. In my stillness is my strength. Today I stop fighting in my own power and let the Lord move in my situation.

peaceShepherd.title: The Lord is my shepherd
peaceShepherd.body: The Lord is my shepherd — I shall not want. He leads me beside still waters, restores my soul, and guides me in paths of righteousness. Today I follow Him with confidence.

strengthRefuge.title: God is my refuge and strength
strengthRefuge.body: God is my refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. I will not fear even when the earth shakes. Today I hide in Him and draw power from His presence.

strengthMountWings.title: I mount up with wings like eagles
strengthMountWings.body: Those who wait on the Lord renew their strength — they mount up with wings like eagles, they run and do not grow weary, they walk and do not faint. Today I choose trust over exhaustion.

strengthMoreThanConq.title: I am more than a conqueror
strengthMoreThanConq.body: In all these things I am more than a conqueror through Him who loved me. Today I walk forward as one who has already overcome in Christ.

faithWalkBy.title: I walk by faith, not by sight
faithWalkBy.body: I walk by faith and not by sight. I do not lean on circumstances but on God's promises. Today I trust Him even when I cannot see the whole road.

faithEvidence.title: Faith is assurance of things unseen
faithEvidence.body: Faith is the assurance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen. Today I hold on to God's promises as a firm anchor in an uncertain world.

faithAsksReceives.title: God hears my prayers
faithAsksReceives.body: This is the confidence I have toward Him: if I ask anything according to His will, He hears me. And if I know He hears, I know I have what I asked. Today I pray boldly.

faithImpossiblePossible.title: With God nothing is impossible
faithImpossiblePossible.body: With God nothing shall be impossible. What is beyond my strength is within reach of His hand. Today I bring Him my impossible and trust Him to act.

healingRestoresSoul.title: God restores my soul
healingRestoresSoul.body: The Lord restores my soul and leads me in paths of righteousness. Where I am tired or broken, His presence brings renewal. Today I receive His refreshing.

healingCloseBroken.title: God is close to the brokenhearted
healingCloseBroken.body: The Lord is near to the brokenhearted and saves those crushed in spirit. Today I know God is nearest when I am most wounded.

healingPhysician.title: Jesus is the physician of my soul
healingPhysician.body: It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick. I come to Jesus with my weakness and my wounds. Today I let Him heal me where no one else can reach.

healingJoyMorning.title: After a night of weeping, joy comes in the morning
healingJoyMorning.body: Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning. My suffering is not my ending. Today I hold on to the promise that a new dawn is coming.

hopeNewMornings.title: God's mercies are new every morning
hopeNewMornings.body: The Lord's mercies never cease — they are new every morning. Great is His faithfulness. Today I wake aware that God's grace is fresh and enough for this day.

hopeWait.title: I wait on the Lord and am strengthened
hopeWait.body: I wait on the Lord, I am of good courage, and He strengthens my heart. Waiting is not loss — it is the place where God builds my strength. Today I wait with trust.

hopeAnchor.title: Hope is the anchor of my soul
hopeAnchor.body: I have hope as an anchor for the soul, sure and steadfast, reaching into the inner place behind the veil where Jesus is. Today I stay anchored in Him no matter the waves.

hopeBeautyAshes.title: God turns ashes into beauty
hopeBeautyAshes.body: God gives those who mourn a crown of beauty instead of ashes, the oil of joy instead of mourning, a garment of praise instead of a spirit of despair. Today I believe He will make something beautiful from my pain.

loveGodSoLoved.title: God loved me enough to give His Son
loveGodSoLoved.body: God so loved the world that He gave His only Son — that whoever believes in Him should not perish but have eternal life. Today I stand in the shadow of that love.

loveEverlasting.title: God loves me with an everlasting love
loveEverlasting.body: I have loved you with an everlasting love — therefore I have continued my faithfulness to you. Today I accept that God's love never ends and never turns away.

loveKnowsName.title: God knows me by name
loveKnowsName.body: Do not fear, for I have redeemed you — I have called you by name; you are mine. God knows me personally, exactly, intimately. Today I live knowing I am seen and known.

gratitudeGiveThanks.title: I give thanks in all things
gratitudeGiveThanks.body: In everything give thanks — for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus for me. Today I find thanksgiving even in hard moments, because God is good.

gratitudeNewSong.title: God put a new song in my mouth
gratitudeNewSong.body: The Lord lifted me out of the pit, set my feet upon a rock, and put a new song in my mouth. Today I sing Him a song of thanks for what He has done.

gratitudeAbundantLife.title: I have life in abundance
gratitudeAbundantLife.body: Jesus came that I might have life, and have it abundantly. Not just survival — fullness. Today I receive that abundance in my relationship with Him.

gratitudeBlessSoul.title: Bless the Lord, O my soul
gratitudeBlessSoul.body: Bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all His benefits. Today I name them one by one — forgiveness, healing, redemption, mercy — and I give thanks.

guidedPrayer.title: Guided Prayer
guidedPrayer.exitAlertMessage: Your progress in this prayer session will be lost.
guidedPrayer.welcomeText: God hears your prayers. Quiet your mind, become aware of His presence, and enter this moment of prayer.
guidedPrayer.prayerInputPlaceholder: What is on your heart today? Entrust it to God…
guidedPrayer.habitMessage: Let prayer become a daily habit. Consistent communion with God builds a peaceful soul.
guidedPrayer.aiSystemPrompt: You are a reverent Christian prayer guide inside a contemplative Bible app. Generate a deep, comforting, short adoration prayer based on the scripture of the day. Language: {{language}}. Tone: peaceful, warm, sacred, and simple. Do not use markdown, section headers, or introductory greetings; return only the prayer text.
guidedPrayer.aiFallbackAdoration: Lord God, in the light of Your word from {{reference}} ("{{text}}"), we praise Your holiness. You are the quiet sanctuary for our restless souls. In this moment of prayer, teach us to rest in Your faithful love. Amen.
